name: Smart Contract Audit: Reentrancy Guard
description: 再入攻撃脆弱性を持つ withdraw 実装を Z3 が検出し、Checks-Effects-Interactions と任意の Lean 証明で資金保存則を検証するデモ

intro: Step 1: LLM generates smart contract withdrawal code...
Step 2: mumei verifies state invariants and fund conservation...
narrative.before: withdraw 関数が external_call 前に再入ロックを取得せず、状態遷移不変条件に違反
narrative.after: Checks-Effects-Interactions と ReentrancyGuard で修正し、残高更新の保存則を任意の Lean 証明で確認

rejected.headline: BUG DETECTED! Invalid reentrancy state transition
follow_up: External call requires the contract to be Locked.
Buggy withdraw performs the external call from Unlocked.

pass.headline: Z3 verified Checks-Effects-Interactions guards
follow_up: external interaction occurs only while the guard is Locked.
Step 4: Optional Lean proof checks withdrawal balance preservation...

steps.name: Z3 Bug Detection: unguarded withdraw
artifact_contract: result.json step status and log capture the expected rejection diagnostic.
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 1 and emits expected rejection evidence (InvalidPreState).

steps.name: Z3 Correct Reentrancy Guard Verification
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (Verification passed, withdraw).

steps.name: Lean Smart Contract Proof Build
artifact_contract: result.json step status and log capture the Lean proof gate evidence.
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (no required output marker).

steps.name: Lean Bridge Certificate
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (dry run: skipping `lake build`).

harness_contract.intent: Prove withdraw follows reentrancy-guard state order and preserves fund-update evidence.
artifact_contracts: Generate evidence: result.json and report.md in reports/{scenario}/latest/ plus per-step logs.
result.json records reentrancy-state rejection, Z3 proof acceptance, and optional Lean gates.
report.md explains the Checks-Effects-Interactions before/after evidence.
smart_contract.proof.json is the L1 Z3 proof certificate for the guarded withdraw implementation.
smart_contract.lean-cert.json is the L3 bridge certificate when Lean assets are available.
dashboard/summary.md aggregates PASS and proof-density evidence for the scenario.
Gate order: l1_z3 -> l3_lean; each stage must satisfy its expected_exit, expected_patterns, artifacts, and depends_on contract before downstream evidence is trusted.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Smart-contract withdraw must lock before external interaction and update balances safely.
success_criteria: unguarded withdraw is rejected with InvalidPreState.
Optional Lean build/bridge certifies smart-contract proof assets when available.
intent_fidelity.drift_risk: Low: gate checks bind the exploit class to explicit state-transition diagnostics.
